messages.text: Thursday, November 5 · Canton, Michigan
Light drizzle meets ancient Mars rocks and a dwarf planet candidate

A day of light drizzle offers a mix of local and distant discoveries. Science news points to a potential dwarf planet beyond Pluto and ancient Martian meteorites, while a local seminar explores complex mathematics. The weather will feel like autumn, with a high near 59°F.
Expect light drizzle today with a high near 59°F and a low around 51°F; there is an 11% chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:12 AM and sunset is at 5:22 PM, with the moon 16.4% illuminated and in a waning crescent phase.
Science and thought in Ann Arbor
The DE Seminar: Non-commutative Singular SPDE is scheduled for 4:00 PM at East Hall in Ann Arbor and is free to attend.
The next new moon is expected on November 9th.
Michigan Democrats secure legislative trifecta

Michigan Democrats have regained full control of the state House and Senate, alongside the governor's office, securing a legislative trifecta. House Minority Leader Ranjeev Puri is expected to continue leading House Democrats.
Looking ahead to the weekend and beyond
Tomorrow brings drizzle and cooler temperatures, with a high near 51°F. The Northern Taurids meteor shower is expected to peak next week.

Friday, November 6 · Canton, Michigan
Drizzle, Raga Jazz, and a New Dwarf Planet Candidate
Expect a damp and cool November day with a chance of drizzle. Tonight, catch a unique blend of Indian ragas and jazz, or explore mathematical concepts in Ann Arbor.
Today will be drizzly with a high near 51°F and a low around 39°F, carrying a 43% chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:14 AM and sunset at 5:21 PM, with a waning crescent moon 9.4% illuminated.
Local Flavors for a Friday

Experience "raga jazz" with pianist and composer Charu Suri at Cliff Bell's in Detroit at 7:30 PM. For a different kind of performance, the Go Comedy Improv Theater in Ferndale presents "Hip Prov" at 9:30 PM.
The Northern Taurids meteor shower is expected to peak on November 11.
Michigan Democrats Secure Legislative Trifecta
Michigan Democrats have regained full control of the state government, securing a legislative trifecta. Abdul El-Sayed won the U.S. Senate seat, becoming the nation's first Muslim U.S. senator.
Looking Toward the Weekend
Tomorrow offers an overcast sky with a high near 52°F. The Southern Taurids meteor shower peaked earlier this week, but the Orionids are still active.
